options.A: Error in C and successful execution in C++
options.B: Error in both C and C++
options.C: Error in C++ and successful execution in C
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: new is a keyword in C++ so it cannot be a variable name, giving a compile error in C++. In C, new is an ordinary identifier, so the program prints 5.

questions.question: What is the purpose of ARP (Address Resolution Protocol)?

options.A: To assign IP addresses to devices
options.B: To resolve domain names to IP addresses
options.C: To map MAC addresses to IP addresses
options.D: To manage network congestion

questions.explanation: ARP provides the mapping between IP addresses and MAC addresses on a LAN (given an IP it finds the matching MAC). DHCP assigns IP addresses and DNS resolves domain names.

questions.question: Inheritance in OOP allows a class to:

options.A: Inherit properties and behavior from another class
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Inheritance lets a subclass acquire the properties and behavior of a superclass, and it also lets the subclass override inherited methods. Creating instances of a class does not need inheritance.

questions.question:
In AI systems, knowledge can be represented in two ways. What are these two ways?
(i) Machine Logic
(ii) Predicate Logic
(iii) Propositional Logic
(iv) Compound Logic

options.D: (iii) and (iv)

questions.explanation: Logical knowledge representation in AI uses propositional logic and predicate (first-order) logic. 'Machine logic' and 'compound logic' are not knowledge representation schemes.

questions.question: For a 2-D array represented in row-major order, the index formula to access the element at row "i" and column "j" using the base address "B" is:

options.D: Index = B + (i * m + j)

questions.explanation: In row-major order, i complete rows of n columns precede row i, then j elements in that row, so the offset is i*n + j (n = number of columns, unit element size). Swapping i and j gives column-major order, and using m (number of rows) is wrong.

questions.question: Which of the following will not select all the cells in a document?

options.A: Using the Edit - Select All menu
options.B: Pressing Ctrl + A on the keyboard
options.C: Clicking three times with the right mouse button in the spreadsheet
options.D: None of these

questions.explanation: Edit > Select All and Ctrl+A both select all cells; triple-clicking the right mouse button does nothing of the kind (right-click opens the shortcut menu).

questions.question: Which transmission media provides the highest transmission speed in a network?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Optical fiber transmits data as light and offers the highest bandwidth and speed, far more than coaxial or twisted-pair cable.

questions.question: Which of the following is a subfield of AI?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Machine learning, robotics and natural language processing are all subfields of artificial intelligence.

questions.question: What is an entity in DTD?

options.A: A reference to an external resource
options.D: A function in JavaScript

questions.explanation: In a DTD, an entity is a named reference that stands for text or an external resource, used as &name; in the document. It is not a tag, equation or JavaScript function.

questions.question: Consider a disk queue with requests for I/O to blocks on cylinders. 98 183 37 122 14 124 65 67 considering FCFS (First Come First Served) scheduling, the total number of head movements is, if the disk head is initially at 53 is?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.question: What is information about data called?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Data about data is called metadata. Teradata is a DBMS product and relations are tables.

questions.question: What is abstract class in C++?

options.A: Any class in C++ is an abstract class/Class from which any class is derived
options.B: Class specifically used as a base class with at least one virtual function
options.C: Class specifically used as a base class with at least one pure virtual function
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A class becomes abstract when it has at least one pure virtual function (= 0). Having just an ordinary virtual function does not make a class abstract.

questions.question: Which of the following options is not available in Paste Special dialog box?

options.D: SQRT

questions.explanation: Paste Special offers None, Add, Subtract, Multiply and Divide operations; SQRT is not available.

questions.question: Which of the following can be considered as the members that can be inherited but not accessible in any class?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Private members of a base class are inherited (they exist in the derived object) but cannot be accessed directly by the derived class. Public and protected members are accessible.

questions.question: If an NFA of 5 states excluding the initial state is converted into a DFA, the maximum possible number of states for the DFA is?
questions.explanation: The NFA has 5 + 1 = 6 states, and subset construction can produce at most 2^6 = 64 DFA states. Using only 5 states gives 32, the tempting wrong answer.

questions.question: In a PLA, what components are used to implement the combinational logic functions?

options.D: NOT gates and multiplexers

questions.explanation: A PLA has a programmable AND array that forms product terms followed by a programmable OR array that sums them, implementing SOP functions.

questions.question: To capture data from the real world, IoT uses ________.

options.D: Microcontroller

questions.explanation: Sensors capture physical data (temperature, motion, light) from the real world for IoT systems. Actuators do the opposite: they act on the environment.

questions.question: Sangeeta asks her colleague for her project work and then copies the entire work and submits it to her team leader claiming it to be her own work. The act performed by Sangeeta is known as ________.

options.D: Virus

questions.explanation: Copying someone else's work and presenting it as one's own is plagiarism. Phishing is fraudulently obtaining credentials, and spamming is sending unsolicited bulk messages.

questions.question: The top level of the hierarchy consists of _____ each of which can contain _____.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: In the SQL environment hierarchy, the top level consists of catalogs, each of which can contain schemas; schemas in turn contain tables and views.

questions.question: The goal of synchronization mechanisms in parallel programming is to:

options.A: Speed up the execution of processes
options.D: Increase the number of race conditions

questions.explanation: Synchronization mechanisms coordinate concurrent processes so that shared resources are accessed safely, avoiding problems such as race conditions and deadlocks. They do not exist to speed up execution, remove parallelism or increase race conditions.

questions.question: Which protocol is used to send email over the Internet?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) is used to send email. FTP transfers files and HTTP transfers web pages.

questions.question: Which of the following data structures finds its use in recursion?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Recursive calls are managed using a stack (the call stack), which stores the activation records of pending calls.

questions.question: Which form of e-marketplace brings together buyers and sellers from the same industry?

options.D: isolated

questions.explanation: A vertical e-marketplace serves buyers and sellers within one industry; a horizontal one serves many industries with common goods/services.

questions.question: In the context of software project management, what is LOC an acronym for?

options.D: List of Components

questions.explanation: LOC stands for Lines of Code, a size metric used for effort and cost estimation in software project management.

questions.question: Who is the father of computer?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Charles Babbage, who designed the Analytical Engine, is called the father of the computer. James Gosling created Java and Dennis Ritchie created C.
